summary: WORK Medical Technology Group LTD filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited financial statements and MD&A for the six months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, containing balance sheet data and notes. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review is disclosed. The company's equity structure changed due to a share split, but this is not a separate corporate action of the type classified here. The report is incorporated by reference into its Form F-3 shelf. No deal terms, board actions, or advisors are mentioned. This is purely an earnings-related disclosure.
